title: Behavioral, new grad product designer, weak answers

questions.text: Tell me about a design project you are proud of.
Tell me about a time a teammate disagreed with your design.
Tell me about feedback on your work that was hard to hear.
Tell me about a time you explained a design choice to someone outside design.
Tell me about something you made that did not work.
Tell me about design work that had a measurable effect on users.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Hi Dara, welcome. I'm Mei, a product designer on the mobile team. This is a thirty minute behavioral conversation, and I will share a tip or two along the way.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hi Mei, thanks. I'm a bit nervous.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: That's fine, take your time. Are you finishing school this term?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, I graduate in May from Marrow Hill University.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Great. I'll ask about three experiences and leave time for your questions at the end.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about a design project you are proud of.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I made an app for a class. It was for finding study spaces. I made the screens and the colors. People liked it and my teacher said it was good.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What was your part in it, and what happened when you showed it to people?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I made the screens and the colors myself. The map screen was hard, so I used a tutorial. Five classmates tested it and four finished the task.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about feedback on your work that was hard to hear.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Sometimes people say the layout is confusing. I try to listen and fix it. Feedback is important for designers.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Can you give me one real example, and what you changed?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: One student said my buttons were too small. I made them bigger. In the next test all five testers found the button.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about a time you explained a design choice to someone outside design.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I explained my colors to my friend in computer science. He said okay. I said it was for readability.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thanks. What questions do you have for me?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: What does a designer do in the first month here?

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: You pair with a senior designer and fix small issues in the live product, so you ship something in your first two weeks.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: That's all our time. Thanks Dara. One tip for next time: add a number to each story. The recruiter will write within a week.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I will try that.

notes: Weak for new grad: short generic first answers; probes bring out one small example each.
